shared_history_component_review.affected_condition: A SQLite consumer accepts attacker-controlled SQL or views.
shared_history_component_review.basis: The vendor build metadata, anchored to the exact control checksum in the previously verified installed APK databases, selects the hash-verified upstream source containing all five src/select.c patch changes and its official regression. Two CTE contexts have later compile guards, recorded explicitly; the current builds enable expression-depth limits.
